title: The Oswego church supper, Lycoming, Oswego County, New York, 1940
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, Epidemiology Program Office
originalSource: New York State Department of Health investigation by A. M. Rubin, 1940, as carried in CDC Case Studies in Applied Epidemiology No. 401-303, Student's Guide, line listing sorted by person.

history.citation: Gross M. Oswego County revisited. Public Health Reports, March-April 1976, 168-170.

transcription: Extracted from the PDF's text layer with pdftotext -layout on 2026-11-01, 75 rows and 21 columns. Values are as CDC prints them, including unk, ? and the asterisk on 12:00 AM. The food column order was taken from the epitools variable order, and the food counts then matched Gross's published table.

verification.treatedAsEqual: unk and ? against NA; a blank onset against NA; 12:00 AM* against 12:00 AM
verification.alsoAgainst: Gross 1976 table of food-specific attack rates: all counts agree except chocolate ice cream among those who did not eat it, 21 there and 20 here, where person 44 is ill with chocolate ice cream unknown.

licenceNote: A United States government publication with no copyright notice found. Generally public domain, not confirmed by a statement in the document.
limits: Meal time is known for 22 of the 46 who were ill.
The church's location is inferred, not established; see place.
The Fieldwork project declares no study design and holds no epidemic curve.

place.chain: Gross 1976 p.169 caption, the single church symbol on USGS Oswego East 1:31,680 (1943), the building in that quarter, 174 Miner Road, Lycoming United Methodist Church. No source read names the church.
